description: A Java source file defining an Android ListActivity subclass 'List8' that demonstrates use of setEmptyView, custom layout, and a custom adapter 'PhotoAdapter' for displaying and managing a list of photos with add and clear functionalities.

classes.name: List8
classes.description: An Android ListActivity subclass demonstrating setEmptyView and a custom photo list adapter.

classes.name: PhotoAdapter
classes.description: A custom adapter extending BaseAdapter that manages a list of photo resource IDs, allowing adding and clearing photos.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets layout, configures empty view, and sets up button click handlers.

methods.name: clearPhotos
methods.description: Clears the photo list and refreshes the display.

methods.name: addPhotos
methods.description: Adds a random photo from the pool to the list and updates the display.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the number of photos in the list.

methods.name: getItem
methods.description: Returns the position as the item (not the actual photo object).

methods.name: getItemId
methods.description: Returns the position as the item ID.

methods.name: getView
methods.description: Creates and returns an ImageView for the photo at the specified position.
